data.subject: Public-records research for Gator Capital
data.body:
Hi,

Gator Capital's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in INBK and CBNA.

On September 10, 2026, INBK entered into a material definitive agreement, according to an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1562463/000156246326000092/inbk-20260910.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue from public records and can also offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
